content.Title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
Topics Covered: Specific Pharmacological Agents for Rate Control
Clinical Recommendations: Intravenous magnesium is effective in rapid control of atrial fibrillation.
Amiodarone can be used rapidly for rate control in acute settings.
